PLAN 06 | THE HUNT ENTERS ORDINARY LIFE
DURATION 15 SECONDS | HORIZONTAL 16:9
CHARACTER REFERENCES
{{CHAR_GUARDS}}  {{CHAR_MARKET_PEOPLE}}
LOCATION REFERENCES
{{LOC_NIGHT_MARKET}}  {{LOC_HIDEOUT_APPROACH}}
PROP REFERENCES
{{PROP_MARKET_STALLS}}
DIRECTION AND CONTINUITY
Create a 15-second horizontal 16:9 live-action cinematic sequence. Preserve each referenced identity, costume, proportions and rigid handmade mask; mask geometry and eye openings remain fixed. All visible humans wear their referenced masks. Emotion comes from posture, hands, breath and visible eyes. Each listed hard cut changes the physical camera station, lens or viewpoint. Handheld movement follows a possible path and recovers focus on essential action. References anchor design; written lighting controls illumination. Tactile modern Iranian mythological design, analog realism and natural imperfections. NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.
LOCATION AND LIGHT
Night market with warm localized stall practicals against deep cool shadow. Integrated lamps hang beneath awnings. The route narrows into a dim masonry passage ending at Jamshid's plain workshop door. Light becomes scarcer along the route.
START STATE AND BLOCKING
Four guards travel from the quay toward the market interior. Lead Guard A and Guard B are in front, Guards C and D follow. The hideout lies beyond the market passage. Maintain forward travel through successive spaces.

PLAN 06 | SHOTS
SHOT 06-01 | 0s–4s | 4 SECONDS
35mm close handheld retreating ahead of the two leading guards. They advance toward camera through a narrow aisle. A vendor pulls a basket inward; a porter turns sideways. The operator retreats with short purposeful steps, keeping their cold forward attention readable.
SHOT 06-02 | 4s–8s | 4 SECONDS
50mm lateral view from between stalls. Guards cross left to right behind a foreground hanging textile. A masked vendor yields, then returns immediately to arranging goods after they pass. Camera shifts to recover the guards beyond the obstruction.
SHOT 06-03 | 8s–12s | 4 SECONDS
28mm rear handheld in the narrowing passage. The four guards move away from camera toward the door. Follow their backs as warm market spill diminishes. The lead pair slow at the threshold; the others retain their positions behind.
SHOT 06-04 | 12s–15s | 3 SECONDS
40mm tight oblique from beside the door. Guard A presses the latch and pushes the door inward. Guard B follows closely. Camera catches only a sliver of the cramped dark interior. Cut on the opening, before the room is fully revealed.
END STATE AND EDIT
The hideout door has opened inward. Guards A and B begin entering; C and D remain in the approach. Continue the same intrusion inside the room.
SOUND
Market movement, baskets, steps and fabric; the bustle recedes into the passage. End on latch, hinge and the first step across the threshold.
NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.

- No human appears without a mask. Every person on screen, including nobles, gift-bearers, servants and background figures, wears a mask. A figure who is not a named character takes one of the masked caste looks in REF-001, Civilization Caste Board. Never show a bare human face.

<<<image_5>>> is China Bazaar (LOC-037 V02); match it wherever China Bazaar appears.
